description: List the threaded replies to a Chat message (ClickUp Chat v3). Returns each reply's id, content, author and timestamp. Paginated via `cursor`/`limit`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (the `next_cursor` returned by a previous call). Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return in this page.

message_id.description: ID of the parent message whose replies to list.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_chat_message_replies
